method: Whole existing province jurisdiction correction; no newly drawn historical boundary

calibrated_sources.basis: Reference source only. Identity matrix is not a source-to-game calibration and is never used for tracing.

limitations: Only the existing northern coastal/Ruegen province is reassigned; the remaining mainland frontier to the Peene is NOT completed.
No city locator is used to allocate an entire neighbouring province; source-map jurisdiction, retained R2 evidence and the northern coastal footprint agree on this existing core.
No calibrated historical frontier is asserted. Peene/Trebel are omitted from native hydrography; adjacent xE1A03A and xA04121 remain unchanged pending defensible local source alignment.
Netze district and Thorn are still unresolved and unchanged; Danzig remains Polish.
No new population, building or country; population/older building redistribution is an exact-integer game-scale allocation, not a historical census.
